function.name: network_query

function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT source_dataset, COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS distinct_dst_ips
FROM network_flows
WHERE protocol = 'TCP'
  AND ((source_dataset = 'ctu13_s5' AND event_time > TIMESTAMP '2011-08-15 17:00:00')
       OR (source_dataset = 'ctu13_s7' AND event_time > TIMESTAMP '2011-08-16 14:00:00'))
GROUP BY source_dataset;"}
